evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative.
